DICETHESPIRE-SCRAP.description: At the end of combat, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] cards to remove from your deck. Obtain its [gold]Gadget[/gold].
DICETHESPIRE-SCRAP.title: Scrap
DICETHESPIRE-TEMPORARY_GADGET.descriptio: A [gold]Gadget[/gold] that lasts until the end of combat. Does not require scrapping an additional card.
DICETHESPIRE-TEMPORARY_GADGET.title: Temporary Gadget
DICETHESPIRE-GADGET.description: Gadgets are items that passively provide you with powerful abilities, but are destroyed after a period of time.
DICETHESPIRE-GADGET.title: Gadget
DICETHESPIRE-BUMP.description: Upgrade the card if possible, otherwise create an unupgraded copy.
DICETHESPIRE-BUMP.title: Bump
DICETHESPIRE-RUMMAGE.description: Discard a chosen number of cards. Draw that many.
DICETHESPIRE-RUMMAGE.title: Rummage
DICETHESPIRE-REROLL.description:
Randomize the cost of a card between 0 and 3 this turn.
Some exceptions apply.
DICETHESPIRE-REROLL.title: Reroll
DICETHESPIRE-NUDGE.description: Reduce a card's cost by 1 until the next time it is played.
DICETHESPIRE-NUDGE.title: Nudge
DICETHESPIRE-INSPECT.description: Look at the top {Cards} cards of the draw pile. You may [gold]Blink[/gold] any of them.
DICETHESPIRE-INSPECT.title: Inspect
DICETHESPIRE-HELD.description: At the end of your turn, if this card is in your hand, this card triggers an effect.
DICETHESPIRE-HELD.title: Held
DICETHESPIRE-RANGE.oneDescription: This card will always randomize to cost [blue]{cost}[/blue].
DICETHESPIRE-RANGE.twoDescription: This card will always randomize to cost between [blue]{min}[/blue] and [blue]{max}[/blue].
DICETHESPIRE-RANGE.title: Range [{values}]
DICETHESPIRE-FLIP.description:
Inverse the cost of a card until the next time it is played this turn.
Cards that cost 3+, cost 0.
Cards that cost 2, cost 1.
Cards that cost 1, cost 2.
Cards that cost 0, cost 3.
DICETHESPIRE-FLIP.title: Flip
